8:34.text: And why should not Allâh punish them while they hinder
from Al-Masjid-Al-Harâm, and they are not its guardians? None can be its guardians except Al-Muttaqûn
, but most of them know not.

8:35.text: (of Allâh, i.e. the Ka‘bah at Makkah)
was nothing but whistling and clapping of hands. Therefore taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve.

8:36.text: Verily, those who disbelieve spend their wealth to hinder
from the Path of Allâh, and so will they continue to spend it; but in the end it will become an anguish for them. Then they will be overcome. And those who disbelieve will be gathered unto Hell.

8:37.text: In order that Allâh may distinguish the wicked
(disbelievers, polytheists and doers of evil deeds)
(believers of Islâmic Monotheism and doers of righteous deeds)
(disbelievers, polytheists and doers of evil deeds)
one over another, heap them together and cast them into Hell. Those! it is they who are the losers.

8:38.text: Say to those who have disbelieved, if they cease
, their past will be forgiven. But if they return

8:39.text: And fight them until there is no more Fitnah
(disbelief and polytheism, i.e. worshipping others besides Allâh)
will all be for Allâh Alone
will all be for Allâh Alone [in the whole of the world
, then certainly, Allâh is All-Seer of what they do.

8:40.text: And if they turn away, then know that Allâh is your Maulâ
